title: page / frontmatter contract
description: The standard every standalone page is held to: pages/*.md, rendered by build.mjs at its own path (not under /blog, not in the feeds). For pages another service points at, such as an app's about page and privacy policy, which App Store Connect links to by URL.

description.description: one line, kept ≤160 chars — meta description and the colophon's link text

path.description: the public, extensionless URL path; the file is written at <path>.html. Fixed once published: other services link to it.

updated.description: ISO date the content last changed in substance; shown on the page

parent.description: path of the page this one belongs under; its back link goes there instead of home. A page with a parent is reached through it, not listed on /colophon.
